name: Third Amendment parts in force after sixty days (r. 1(3)(a))

attrs.quote: regulation 4, regulation 6, regulation 8(a) and regulation 18, which shall come into force after sixty days
attrs.scope: its regulations 4 (A2P call declaration), 6 (VNOs on DLT), 8(a) (misuse of Headers or Content Templates) and 18 (regulation 35A)
attrs.note: window is computed: 60 days after publication in the Official Gazette, dated 18 September 2026.
